descriptions.source: Holds the authoritative specs and platform-level ADRs that other repos build against.
descriptions.build: Holds build-specs and implementation ADRs that cite a source.
descriptions.standalone: One repo that is both source and build; specs and ADRs co-located; intra-repo citations. First-class.

descriptions.docs: Human-facing prose: guides, overviews, published documentation.
descriptions.spec: A specification: requirements, functional/architecture specs, plans.
descriptions.adr: An Architecture Decision Record: an immutable, namespaced ruling.

derived_from.subject: spec
derived_from.description: This spec is derived from an upstream spec.

subject: spec
plan
cites.description: This spec/plan is bound by the cited decision.

implements.subject: code
implements.description: This code implements the named spec.

supersedes.subject: adr
supersedes.description: This decision replaces an earlier one (which becomes historical, not deleted).

references.subject: any
references.description: Untyped fallback only: a cross-reference whose precise relation is unknown. Never use when a typed relation fits.

descriptions.declared: Written in a config/front-matter and validated. Highest trust.
descriptions.identifier: A shared qualified identifier (an ADR ID or NNN-feature-slug) appearing in two places. Deterministic.
descriptions.prose: A literal cross-reference found in source text. Lowest trust; must quote the evidence.

rules: Namespace is a repo-chosen uppercase prefix identifying the repo's role/position in the domain (declared in the repo's config), not the project name.
An un-prefixed 'ADR-NNN' inherits the configured namespace of the repo it lives in (read as '<namespace>-ADR-NNN'); adoption requires no file renames.
The fully-qualified form is canonical and required for cross-repo citations; a bare 'ADR-NNN' resolves only within its own repo.
Numbers are allocated at acceptance; a not-yet-accepted decision occupies no number.
Accepted ADR bodies are immutable above an '## Amendments' heading.
A decision change is a new ADR that supersedes the old.

citation_slots.description: Where the typed citation slots live and how their values are written. Readers parse these to recover derived_from/cites edges directly, rather than inferring them from prose.

derived_from.discriminator: a colon (':') marks a cross-repo reference; a value with no colon is intra-repo
derived_from.source_member_id: the domain-manifest member name (== the citing repo's sources[].id)
derived_from.spec_feature_id: the feature directory name under the source's specs_dir

cites.intra_repo: MAY be bare ADR-NNN (interpreted under the citing repo's namespace)
